segments.text: Race: Demon
Role: Demon Queen
The Demon Queen who ruled the country and was sealed away 1,000 years ago by a "hero".

Despite this, she seems to hold no ill will towards humanity. In fact, she seems to like them quite a bit, and is eager to hear their stories. During the time she ruled the area, she introduced many cultural and technological innovations from the Demon World, like the concept of insurance, and the game of Chess. She is fond of books and games, and is constantly asking Kazuto to buy her more.

Her power is sealed by six Seal Stones that are buried throughout the mountain. At first, she appears as a phantom, barely able to interact with the world. As more of the stones are recovered, she regains her physical form, and eventually her full power. She doesn't want any lives to be lost for the sake of her revival, even if they see her as an enemy.

While it is told that she was a tyrant who took over the country, the truth is that she was friends with the human queen who was the previous ruler. The queen willingly passed on the throne to Karin, who took it to help her friend. The human queen and her husband took on ordinary lives. However, their child was unsatisfied with such a life and felt that they deserved the throne that was their birthright. They sealed Karin away, and vilified her, leading them to be known as a "hero".
朽ちた迷宮の奥深く、封印されし魔王は思う。
ちゃんと『魔王復活保険』に加入していたのに、もう千年近く経ってしまった。
何か手違いがあったのだろうか。
どうでもいいから誰か復活させてくれないかしら。
怒りに震えるわけでもなく、現実を受け止める。
それこそが魔王の器量、かどうか分からないが、魔王カリンは、ただその時を待っていた。
予感はあるのだ。きっ近々やってくる。
人間も魔族も隔てなく支配する。
そんな心優しき独裁者が、一人の青年と出会った時。
そこにはきっと素敵な迷宮があるのだろう。
誰もが病棟に楽しめるような、世界一の迷宮が。
異世界の魔王。
アルトの夢の中に登場し、時に助言を与えてくれる存在。
大切なものを取り戻すために、世界を越えて探索をしているらしい。
ただし、この世界に目的のものはなく、普段は魔道具を使い、時々、魔塔を観察しているようだ。
あちらの世界も色々あるようで息抜きのようなものだろう。
ただし、相手は魔王。
ただの息抜きで終わるはずもなく……
好奇心の塊である彼女と六人の選ばれし配下たちが、煉獄へと来る未来はそう遠くないのかもしれない。
Race: Demon
Role: Merchant

An employee of Gyunguska Inc, a major company in the Demon World. The company holds an Insurance contract with the Demon Queen Karin from 1,000 years ago. In the event that Karin should be sealed away, the company would send someone to release her. Fuu came to the human world to do so. However, digging through the mountain to find the Seals would cost a lot of gold, so she came up with a plan to fund the excavation: Create a dungeon.

In truth, the company that Karin originally signed the contract with was called Malmorget. Unfortunately, around the time Karin was sealed, Malmorget was absorbed in a merger with Gyunguska Inc. During the merger, the contract with Karin was overlooked, resulting in the 1,000 year delay. As a former employee of Malmorget, Fuu was the one who originally signed the contract with Karin. She felt an obligation to fix the mistake of her former company and personally took responsibility for resurrecting Karin.
She is unable to directly participate in combat, so she instead controls a combat golem called Houkei.
まさか「魔王復活保険」が忘れられてたなんて。
あってはならないことです。
しかし、簡単に諦めるフウではありません。
一度結んだ契約は絶対に履行してみせます。
たとえ、商人としてのキャリアを失う可能性があったとしてもーー
「ギュンギュンスカー商会」に失敗などありえない。
やり手の商人は「魔王復活」の為に必要なものを探し続ける。
そして、最後のピースを見つけると、特大の笑顔を作り、こう声をかけるのだ。
Race: Demon
Role: Berserker

A demon from the Demon Realm. Karin attempted to contact her old subordinate, Shikou Karon and request her assistance. However, Shikou died around 500 years ago. Her great grandchild Karon received the call instead and decided to answer the summons herself as training. She ended up attacking the Dungeon, assuming that being summoned to a Dungeon meant to attack it. Once captured, she revealed her history and became Karin's servant, joining the Dungeon's forces.

A cheerful and upbeat girl who spends most of her free time training. While people often assume that she is unintelligent, she has been raised to be a leader and is educated. Her subordinates all care for her dearly. Knowing that she has feelings for Kazuto, her subordinates often arrange for the two of them to end up together, and enjoy peeping on their progress.
ここどこっすか……おなかすいたっす……
魔王に呼び出された狂戦士は、迷宮で迷子になっていた。
主の下で、思う存分、戦いに明け暮れる。
そんな楽しい未来を想像してニヤけていた頃が懐かしい。
もう壁を壊して進むしかないっすね……
そう呟く少女、それは迷宮にとって、もはや災害であった。
「いたぞー！罠にかけろ！」「捕まえろー！」
立ちはだかる迷宮の魔物たち。
大人しく保護されれば、暖かなベッドと食事が提供されるだろう。
しかし、そんな事など知らないカロンは、
疲れ果てるまで迷宮で暴れ続けるのだった。
「もっと早く言ってほしかったっす！」
Race: Human
Role: Wizard (specializes in black magic)

She first shows up as a mysterious merchant who sets up shop outside of the Dungeon. She reveals herself to be a Black Magic Wizard who worships Demon Queen Karin and has been seeking her out to serve her.

She is a man hater who especially despises Kazuto's presence next to her beloved Karin. Her hatred does not stem from any trauma or specific reason, she just thinks men are disgusting. She is often eager for accomplishments.
彼女は闇の魔法を操る超一流の魔法使いだ。
そんな彼女が魔族、いや魔王に惹かれる事など必然以外の何物でもない。
私、いや、彼女が魔王さまの参謀になったとしたら、人間などひとたまりもないだろう。
あぁ、魔王さま、魔王さま。
どうか私の貴女の配下に加えてください。
え？このみずぼらしい男が同僚？
え！？迷宮運営者？この世はいつから地獄になったの？いいえ、今は我慢しましょう。
実力でこんな奴、追い落としてみせます。
これは私、いやケイファが魔王さまと二人で世界を支配する物語。
うるさい、アンタの感想なんて聞いてないのよ！
Race: Human
Role: Adventurer

A cheerful, tomboyish princess. She rides a strange mechanical panda into battle that shoots lasers from its mouth. Wanting adventure, she sneaks away from her guards and older sister to explore the Labyrinth. While she fails and is humiliated by Shunran spanking her, she comes to know Kazuto and understands the non-lethal nature of the Dungeon. She often returns to challenge Shunran again to redeem herself, growing closer to Kazuto in the process.
勇者の血統でありながら自由気ままに生きる少女。
と言っても勇者である姉も自由なのだから、問題はない。
今日もパンダに跨り、行きたい所に行く。
「あ！ あっちでなんか楽しそうなことやってる！」
彼女の行動原理といえば、この程度のものなのだ。
「新しい迷宮？ わー、すっごい楽しそう！！」
ようはワクワクできればなんでもいいのである。
元気印のシャオは青年カズトと出会い、どう変わっていくのか。
いや、きっと変わらず自由だろう。
それこそが彼女の魅力なのだから。
にしても、この姉妹の自由さはなんだろう。
勇者の血かな。
Race: Human
Role: Adventurer & Hero

The descendant of the "hero" who sealed Karin away. When she recognizes Karin on one of her trips into to town, she confronts her. Karin tells her to come challenge her in the dungeon. When defeated, she expects Karin to kill her, but Karin does not, and tells her to look at things through her own eyes, and not just blindly follow legends.
魔王不在のこの時代。それでも勇者は居る。 倒すべき相手のいない勇者レンファは……冒険者として堅実に生きていた。
漫画にハマリ、仲間と狩りにいく年相応な女の子として。
ご先祖さまには申し訳ないが、仕方がない。 だって魔王なんて千年近く居ないのだから。 もちろん、冒険者として剣の腕は磨いている。 いつかあるかもしれない戦いの為に。 漫画だって一緒だ。いつか……あるかもしれない出会いの為に。
だから、恋愛漫画を読み漁るのも修行のうちなの、 本当よ。
魔王復活の足音が忍び寄る中、レンファは今日も新たな漫画を求めて雑貨屋を巡る。
Race: Human
Role: Adventurer (Thief)

An adventurer who loves cats. When all the cats in town seem to vanish because they all were drawn to the Dungeon, she assumes that someone maliciously kidnapped them and attacks the Dungeon to rescue them. Once the misunderstanding is cleared, she becomes friends with the residents of the Dungeon and sometimes brings other adventurers to try it out.

She believes that anyone who is liked by cats is automatically a good person: that is why she came to trust the Dungeon residents. Minmei is a fairly successful adventurer, and does make good money. However, she eats drastically more than a normal person, thus consuming most of her earnings. What she has left goes towards buying food for stray cats in town.
Minmei's dream is to create a Feline Paradise to protect and raise cats. She wants to save up to make that dream a reality.
When Kazuto hears her dreams, he comes up with the concept of a Cat Cafe, where the cats can be raised, and contribute to earning money to support them. He agrees to help her with that goal.
盗賊と言っても、盗みを働いたりしません。
これも立派な冒険者の職業なんです。
だって適性検査で
『身軽ですか／ＹＥＳ』
『器用ですか／ＹＥＳ』
『気配を消すのが上手いですか／ＹＥＳ』
『はい、あなたは盗賊ですね』ですよ！
酷くないですか！
いえ、今の職業は気に入っているのですが。
そう語るミンメイだが、実はこの話、彼女の物語にはあまり関係がないのです。
だって、彼女を語る上で欠かせないのは職業ではなく、『お猫様』なのだから。
これは、猫の為に戦い、時に猫耳を生やし、尻尾も生やし、ミンメイがお猫様ランドを築くまでのサクセスストーリー。
嘘のような本当の話です。
Race: Demon
Role: Her sister's bodyguard (Archer)

The younger daughter of the Ogre Warqueen, a ruler in the Demon Realm. When her sister went missing, she came looking for her. Upon hearing that the last place she was seen was a Dungeon, she assumed that her sister was captured and attacked the Dungeon to rescue her. Once the situation was resolved, she joined her elder sister under Karin.
She tends to hide her emotions, besides her love for her sister, who she idolizes. She is the one who often is taking care of her sister in their daily life.

She loves her sister more than anyone, but she does still want to get married and have children someday. Which is why she decided that she would marry the same man as her sister so that they could all stay together.
姉のシュンランと双璧をなす戦鬼、または迷宮の常識人、または狙った獲物は逃がさない超一流の弓戦士。
他にも色々な呼び名が彼女にはある。
しかし、どれか一つと言うのであれば、それは『姉の保護者』だろう。
その一言で彼女の人となりが分かるというものである。
「姉者、酒でも一緒にどうだ」
「姉者、肩を揉んでやろう」
「姉者、この間、面白い事があってな」
その過保護っぷりこそ、姉を傍若無人にした原因なのだが、そんな事はシュウランに関係なかった。
姉者が楽しそうに暮らしている。それこそ妹である彼女の幸せだ。
姉のお気に入りにされた人間へ同情はするが、助けたりしない。彼女もまた自分勝手なのだ 。
Race: Demon
Role: Warrior

The older daughter of the Ogre Warqueen, a ruler in the Demon Realm. When she heard that Karin was looking for more help and her mother was too busy, she decided to go instead. Unfortunately, she didn't bother to tell any of her family this before leaving.
She has a tendency to solve everything with violence, but also has a child-like innocence. She values her family greatly.
あっはっはと笑いながら、のっしのっしと迷宮を歩く。その姿は勇ましく、誰もが見惚れるほど雄大だった。
そう、シュンランは迷宮の最大戦力だ。
圧倒的な実力者であり、畏怖の対象、そして魔王の片腕として迷宮に君臨している。
そんな彼女が見回りの仕事を終えて、今日も生活 区に戻ってくる。
その場に居た魔物たちに緊張が……走らない。
「んあ～、一日よく働いたな。カズト！ 酒だ！」
「カズト！ 肩揉め！」「カズト！ 面白い話しろ！」
被害者は常に迷宮運営者である人間なのだから。
可哀想だとは思うが、関わろうとする魔物がいるわけがない。
今日も鬼の姉御は運営者を顎で使い、楽しそうに暮らしている。それでいいじゃないか。
Race: Human
Role: Guild Staff & Adventurer

An adventurer with a strong sense of justice, who investigates the suspicious Dungeon mentioned by her friend Minmei. At first she is extremely suspicious of Kazuto and the other Dungeon dwellers, but comes to understand that they do not mean any harm.
She constantly wears an iron mask covering her whole face. When she has that mask on, she is unshakeable, but she gets easily embarrassed without it.
鉄仮面は正義の証である。
弱気を助け、強気を挫く。
その正体は……冒険者ギルドの姐さんだ！
尚、普段から仮面をつけたり外したりしているので、正体を隠しているわけではなく、彼女の趣味なのだが。
そんな彼女が人間が運営している迷宮を許すだろうか。
いや、許すはずがない。
敵対者としてカズトの前に立ちはだかる正義の人。
そこに割って入るのがシュンランなのだから話は拗れる事、必至。
はたして、シシュンの正義とカズトの迷宮愛、勝つのはどちらか！？
Race: Human
Role: Adventurer
An adventurer who especially loves dungeons. He spends his free time researching old dungeons. When his adventurer party breaks up and he is broke, Fuu appears before him with an job offer:
Use his expertise to design a dungeon that will attract adventurers from all over. Doing so will help gather funds necessary to excavate the 5 seals that are restricting the Demon Queen Karin.

While a bit hesitant, Kazuto accepts, eager at the possibility of designing his own dungeon, though with the understanding that the dungeon will not seek to kill any adventurers, only take their money.
In Karin's events, it is revealed that Kazuto is descended from the sibling of the "hero" that sealed Karin away. That sibling sided with Karin.
彼は初心者を脱した中級冒険者。
ほどよく稼ぎ、ほどよく失敗し、ほどよく生き残っていた。
このまま冒険者としてやっていきたい。
しかし、彼の望みとは逆に世界は動く。
だが、世界は彼の敵ではない。
世界は彼の本当の望みを叶えようとしていただけだった。
彼の本当の望みは──

A knight that is chasing after Shion to arrest her. She heard rumors that Shion was running a research facility in the Dungeon and came attacking. Upon talking to Kazuto, they realized those rumors were spread by Shion herself, using Sui to investigate the Dungeon without getting directly involved. She agrees to work with Kazuto against Shion.

She comes from a family of knights that are known for raising Pegasi. She has a strong obsession with horses of all kinds. However, she wasn't able to bring her Pegasus with her. While living in the Human Realm, Kazuto recommends that she become an adventurer to earn money. She does, and wants to save money to buy a horse. At times, it seems like she has forgotten her mission.

A small adventurer with a huge axe and overwhelming power. An old acquaintance of Kazuto from his adventuring days. Kazuto was a mentor to her when she was first starting out, and she is very found of him. Karin takes a liking to her, and invites her to join the Dungeon.

She is actually a mixed-blood of human and demon. Afraid of people learning of her demon blood, she always travelled around and never made close connections. Meeting the residents of the Dungeon, she realizes that no one here would judge her for her blood and she would have a home.
Shion's daughter who loves her very much.

Riri wasn't born, she was created through Shion's research. She was born with extraordinary abilities reminiscent of Angels. Celestials are merely residents of the Celestial Realm, while Angels are something else entirely. Realizing that Riri will be exploited, Shion fled to the Human Realm with Riri. Shion seeks to find a way to remove Riri's powers so that she can grow up a normal girl.

The leader of the Pochi Tribe. Her tribe attacks the Dungeon. Upon being beaten, she becomes extremely attached to Kazuma. She and her whole tribe agree to work for him, in exchange for him fathering their children.
She often behaves like a dog, responding to commands like "Stay", and "Lay Down" when they come from Kazuma, who she calls Master.

A succubus with a childish body. She attends a reform school for succubi who lack sex appeal, that trains them into Succubattlers. She and her friends tend to behave like delinquents, and pick a fight when they hear about the Dungeon.
Due to her low self-esteem from always being considered a failure as a succubus, she is extremely weak to praise, and quickly falls for Kazuto's sweet talk, agreeing to join his forces.

A girl that seeming fell from the sky as a shooting star. When Kazuto finds her, she has no memory of who she is. She only knows her name is Touka, and that she was there on an important mission. She has a sensation as if she is missing something above her head. She settles into a small village while she tries to get her bearings. Kazuto checks in on her to see how she is doing. Not knowing how to explain her relationship with Kazuto to the villagers, she decides to call him Goushuji-sama.
Even without most memories, she remembers that she is very clumsy, and that someone often helped her when she got into trouble.

When she meets Aisha, she regains most of her memories. Touka is in fact a Celestial from the Heavenly Realm. She has a special Oracle power that gives her information on the future. She came to the Dungeon because she had an oracle telling her that a great power was there that would greatly affect the future. Unfortunately, an accident occurred, and er Halo, that stabilized her powers was sent flying somewhere, causing her to lose her strength and memories.

A mysterious woman adventurer that Kazuto meets in town. She casts charm magic on Kazuto, trying to investigate the Dungeon. However, when she learns of Kazuto's true role in the Dungeon, and the presence of Karin, she stops and tries to distance herself. She has a daughter named Riri that she cares for greatly.

A researcher from the Heavenly Realm. Her research was considered dangerous, and she fled to the Human Realm with her daughter Riri. When the shooting star (Touka) crashed near the Dungeon, she recognized Celestial energy and was investigating out of fear that it was someone pursuing her.

Touka's friend, (and attendant) who always took care of her. When she lost track of Touka, she attacked the Dungeon assuming that Touka was captured. She initially is not willing to trust demons, but Touka convinces her to get along with the residents of the Dungeon. She decides to stay in the village with Touka.

A childish Demon King of an island full of monsters. Kazuto makes her acquaintance while advertising the Dungeon. An optimistic and friendly girl. She wanted to make friends with lots of people, and ended up uniting the island's forces in the process. She becomes fast friends with Kazuto as well.
In truth, she is not a demon. she is a normal Beastman. However, she was the one who picked up Touka's Halo, granting her great power. The monsters started calling her Demon King after that.
